from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Introduction: From Noise to Art", [
            "Text-to-image AI generates art from pure noise.", 
            "This is fundamentally a de-noising process.", 
            "Imagine a snowy screen refining into an image."
        ])
        
        # Noise visualization
        noise = VGroup(*[Dot() for _ in range(200)])
        for d in noise:
            d.move_to(np.array([np.random.uniform(1.5, 5.5), np.random.uniform(-1.5, 2.5), 0]))
            d.set_color(WHITE)
            
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture_lines[0], shift=RIGHT), FadeIn(noise))
        self.lecture_lines[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture_lines[1], shift=RIGHT))
        self.lecture_lines[1].set_color("#FFD700")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture_lines[2], shift=RIGHT))
        self.lecture_lines[2].set_color("#00FFFF")
        
        diffusion_text = Text("Diffusion Model", font_size=36, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(diffusion_text, 'C3')
        self.play(Write(diffusion_text))
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["CLIP bridges the gap between text and images.", "It maps them into a shared vector space.", "Words and images become mathematically close points."]
        self.setup_layout("CLIP: The Linguistic Bridge", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors per B039

        COLOR_CONNECT = "#00FF00"
        COLOR_SPACE = "#FFFFFF"

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Diffusion models learn to reverse Gaussian noise.",
            "Forward diffusion adds noise to images.",
            "Reverse diffusion reconstructs the original signal.",
            "A neural network predicts the noise.",
            "Gradient fields guide the image's refinement."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Diffusion Mathematics: The Reverse Path", lecture_lines)
        
        # Elements
        img = Circle(radius=0.5, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.5)
        noise = VGroup(*[Dot(point=np.random.randn(3)*0.5, color=GREY) for _ in range(50)])
        formula = MathTex(r"x_t = \sqrt{1-\beta}x_{t-1} + \sqrt{\beta}\epsilon").scale(0.8)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF4500"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF4500"))
        self.place_at_grid(img, "B2")
        self.add(img)
        self.play(Transform(img, noise))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))
        noise_copy = noise.copy()
        self.place_at_grid(noise_copy, "B5")
        self.play(Transform(noise_copy, img))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "D3")
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        field = VGroup(*[Arrow(start=self.grid["E2"]+0.5*RIGHT, end=self.grid["E2"]+0.5*LEFT, color=BLUE) for _ in range(5)])
        self.add(field)
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Synthesis combines CLIP and diffusion models.",
            "CLIP provides a textual target direction.",
            "The diffusion model iteratively refines the image.",
            "Loss is minimized between noise and text.",
            "The loop creates the final generated art."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Synthesis: The Feedback Loop", lecture_lines)
        
        # Elements
        clip_box = Rectangle(width=2, height=1, color=BLUE).set_fill(BLUE, opacity=0.3)
        diff_box = Rectangle(width=2, height=1, color=PURPLE).set_fill(PURPLE, opacity=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(clip_box, "B4")
        self.place_at_grid(diff_box, "D4")
        
        clip_text = Text("CLIP", font_size=20).move_to(clip_box)
        diff_text = Text("Diffusion", font_size=20).move_to(diff_box)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF8C00")
        self.play(Create(clip_box), Write(clip_text), Create(diff_box), Write(diff_text))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF8C00")
        prompt = Text("Prompt", font_size=18, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(prompt, "B2")
        arrow = Arrow(prompt.get_right(), clip_box.get_left(), color=WHITE)
        self.play(FadeIn(prompt), GrowArrow(arrow))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF8C00")
        image_node = Circle(radius=0.4, color=WHITE).set_fill(WHITE, opacity=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(image_node, "D2")
        self.play(FadeIn(image_node))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#32CD32")
        loss_text = Text("Loss = min(d)", font_size=16, color="#32CD32")
        self.place_at_grid(loss_text, "E4")
        self.play(Write(loss_text))

        target_icon = Star(color=YELLOW).scale(0.3)

        self.play(FadeIn(target_icon))
        self.wait(1)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "AI creativity is high-dimensional statistical probability.",
            "Models navigate learned latent spaces.",
            "They don't copy, they generate anew."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Conclusion and Real-world Impact", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # AI creativity is high-dimensional statistical probability.
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FA9A")
        icons = VGroup(
            Dot(color="#00FA9A"),
            Square(color="#00FA9A", fill_opacity=0.3),
            Circle(color="#00FA9A", fill_opacity=0.3)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        self.place_in_area(icons, 'A1', 'C3')

            Circle(radius=0.1 + i*0.05, color="#FF00FF") for i in range(5)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT)
        self.place_at_grid(latent_progression, 'D2')
        self.play(FadeIn(latent_progression))
        self.play(latent_progression.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: The Mechanics of Imagination: Diffusion, CLIP, and Image Synthesis
outline.target_audience: University students with basic knowledge of linear algebra and calculus

sections.title: Introduction: From Noise to Art
sections.content: A 45-second overview: Define text-to-image generation as a 'de-noising' process. Use an animation of a static 'snowy' television screen gradually transforming into a high-definition image of a golden retriever.
sections.example: Visualizing a noisy pixel cloud slowly sculpting itself into a recognizable puppy.

sections.title: CLIP: The Linguistic Bridge
sections.content: A 60-second explanation of CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training). Explain how CLIP projects text and images into a shared vector space (Multi-modal Embedding), allowing the model to 'understand' that the word 'cat' is mathematically close to an image of a cat.
sections.example: A 2D coordinate plane where the word 'Cat' and a photo of a Siamese cat are plotted near each other as high-dimensional points.

sections.title: Diffusion Mathematics: The Reverse Path
sections.content: A 90-second focus on the math of the reverse diffusion process. Explain Forward Diffusion (adding Gaussian noise: q(x_t|x_{t-1})) and Reverse Diffusion (the neural network learning to predict the noise: p_θ(x_{t-1}|x_t)). Use the concept of a Gradient Field guiding the image toward the 'clean' state.
sections.example: A vector field diagram showing how the model follows the gradient to push a blurry pixel configuration toward a clearer, more detailed shape.

sections.title: Synthesis: The Feedback Loop
sections.content: A 75-second integration section. Show how CLIP provides the 'Target Direction' (text prompt) and the Diffusion model provides the 'Step-by-Step Refinement' to reach that target, minimizing the loss between the noisy image and the text embedding.
sections.example: A flowchart showing: Prompt -> CLIP Embedding -> Iterative Denoising -> Final Image of an 'Astronaut riding a horse'.

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-world Impact
sections.content: A 30-second summary: Reiterate that creativity in AI is essentially high-dimensional statistical probability. Emphasize that these models don't 'copy' art but navigate a latent landscape learned from billions of samples.
sections.example: The transformation of a prompt into a dynamic, generated piece of art in seconds.
